boundary: Candidate4 writer uses awaited writeFile with wx but no explicit file sync. Exclusive creation and retained exact bytes were tested; power-loss persistence was not established. Any reference to durable journals in the offline acceptance must be read with this limitation.
execution_requirement: Before any side effect, actual executor must persist an exclusive intent and explicitly sync it through a reviewed writer, or use a separate independently reviewed synced pre-action journal. Candidate4 unsynced writer alone is insufficient for crash-durable at-most-once execution. Stop/provider/executor acceptance remains separate.
scope: No claim of full power-loss resilience can be obtained from mocked sync-call tests alone; those can establish required call ordering/mechanism. Filesystem and host durability assumptions must remain explicit.
root_origin: Root identified missing explicit sync after Candidate4 offline result; QA confirms static writer source. First final report preserved unchanged with this separate narrower supplement.
